mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 57 degrees with clear skies observed at Harriet Park and we are currently under a New Moon phase.
City leaders have been busy with the Common Council unanimously adopting the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to manage future development and growth.
There is plenty to do with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, plus yoga tomorrow, and a full slate of trivia and the downtown farmer's market starting next week.
In a noteworthy update, on October 3, the police department recovered a stolen firearm and arrested a suspect following a traffic stop for expired registration.
You can look forward to the delicious Caramel Cashew flavor of the day when Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM.
